<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

Performance-only diffusion failures, such as Z-Image stage latency regressions, can produce no consistency artifact. Without coverage recommendations, the analyzer then skips execution and succeeds without creating `failure_report.md`.

Ensure these failures produce a report and make missing diagnostics explicit.

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

- Save per-test outcomes, phases, error types/messages, available actual/baseline/threshold values, and source run metadata in `diffusion-test-summary.json`.
- Capture partition logs for the 1-NPU and 2-NPU suites while preserving the test command's exit status.
- Run analysis without requiring recommendations or consistency artifacts. Read structured results and logs alongside existing consistency summaries.
- Include upstream diffusion job outcomes, flag failed jobs without test diagnostics, and keep skipped/cancelled jobs separate from failures.
- Surface analysis errors and fail the report upload when `failure_report.md` is missing.

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

Five local regression tests passed, covering performance-only failures, HTTP/setup failures, collection-log fallback, missing artifacts, skipped/cancelled jobs, and legacy consistency artifacts. The temporary test file was removed after validation.

Ruff lint and formatting checks, YAML parsing, shell syntax checks, and `git diff --check` passed. Live NPU CI validation remains pending.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

No inference runtime changes. No NPU performance benchmark was run.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

 import json
 import os
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
 
 import pytest
 
 _PERF_RESULTS = pytest.StashKey[list]()
 
 
+@pytest.hookimpl(hookwrapper=True)
+def pytest_runtest_makereport(item, call):
+    report = (yield).get_result()
+    artifact_dir = os.environ.get("SGLANG_DIFFUSION_ARTIFACT_DIR")
+    if not artifact_dir or (report.when != "call" and report.passed):
+        return
+
+    error = str(call.excinfo.value) if call.excinfo else ""
+    run_id = os.environ.get("GITHUB_RUN_ID")
+    run_url = (
+        f"{os.environ.get('GITHUB_SERVER_URL', 'https://github.com')}/"
+        f"{os.environ.get('GITHUB_REPOSITORY')}/actions/runs/{run_id}"
+        if run_id
+        else None
+    )
+    record = {
+        "testcase": item.nodeid,
+        "status": report.outcome,
+        "phase": report.when,
+        "error_type": call.excinfo.typename if call.excinfo else None,
+        "error": error,
+        "baseline": None,
+        "actual": None,
+        "threshold": None,
+        "job": os.environ.get("GITHUB_JOB"),
+        "job_url": os.environ.get("GITHUB_JOB_URL"),
+        "run_id": run_id,
+        "run_url": run_url,
+    }
+    for key, label in (
+        ("baseline", "Expected"),
+        ("actual", "Actual"),
+        ("threshold", "Limit"),
+    ):
+        match = re.search(rf"\b{label}:\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)", error)
+        if match:
+            record[key] = float(match.group(1))
+
+    # Persist each result so later setup failures or interrupted sessions retain evidence.
+    path = Path(artifact_dir) / "diffusion-test-summary.json"
+    try:
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        records = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else []
+        records.append(record)
+        temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
+        temporary.write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
+        temporary.replace(path)
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+        print(f"::warning:: Cannot write diffusion test summary: {exc}")
+
+

     """Share results through pytest rather than importing this conftest module."""
